title: Kids Playing Pretend Rock Band in Backyard, 1964 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Captured in September 1964 during the height of American Beatlemania, four young children enthusiastically play pretend rock band on a backyard patio. Three girls hold handcrafted toy guitars while wearing mop-top wigs and matching white tops with dark capris or pants, accompanied by a drummer using drumsticks on an upright wooden barrel. A cinderblock wall and subtropical shrubbery frame the suburban outdoor scene.
